answer: Farming stops paying when the bill tops the prize, and here the bill is 65286 POA against one epoch's reward. The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. Give the epoch a backbone: Chapel frescoist wet-plaster lunette seal brushed onto the baptistery dome, proved by each wet-plaster lunette is a measured pigment yield plus a guild signature, checked by strangers. The mirror points at a person the farm never met, the quartz points at a sum the farm never owned, the dawn points at a year the farm never lived.
